extracted.intended_audience: policymakers, advocates, journalists, and informed citizens interested in judicial reform
extracted.subtask_description: Normative criteria and policy goals used to evaluate courts and to guide judicial-reform advocacy at the Supreme, federal, and state levels. Covers ethics, independence, fairness, diversity, and institutional reforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Courts should protect civil rights, democratic values, and the rule of law
rubrics_metrics.description: Our courts should be bulwarks to protect civil rights, democratic values, and the rule of law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Brennan Center frames courts as institutions that must guard core democratic principles; reforms should be assessed by whether they strengthen courts' capacity to protect rights, democratic norms, and legal order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evenhanded justice / impartiality
rubrics_metrics.description: The promise of evenhanded justice is at risk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate courts by whether they deliver impartial, evenhanded outcomes rather than outcomes influenced by politics, money, or special interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enforceable ethics code for Supreme Court justices
rubrics_metrics.description: The Kohlberg Center promotes urgently needed changes, including ... an enforceable ethics code for the justices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A standard for reform: create binding ethical rules and enforcement mechanisms for Supreme Court justices to address scandals and conduct issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Term limits for Supreme Court justices
rubrics_metrics.description: The Kohlberg Center promotes urgently needed changes, including term limits ... for the justices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider adopting term limits as a reform metric to reduce lifetime accumulation of unchecked power and to renew institutional legitimacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accountability for long-tenured justices
rubrics_metrics.description: Justices wield tremendous power for decades with little accountability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether institutional reforms increase accountability for long tenures (e.g., transparency, ethics enforcement, processes that check abuse of power).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce money influence in state judicial elections
rubrics_metrics.description: Judicial elections are awash in money, and judges regularly hear cases involving major contributors to their campaigns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A criterion for state-court reform is limiting campaign money's role and preventing conflicts of interest where contributors appear before judges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect judicial independence from political retaliation
rubrics_metrics.description: Lawmakers have sought to rein in judges whose rulings they don’t like.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether rules and structures insulate judges from political retaliation and preserve independent decisionmaking, including resisting legislative and executive pressures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to a fair day in court
rubrics_metrics.description: The right to a fair day in court is under threat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure court systems by whether individuals receive fair proceedings and outcomes; reforms should safeguard procedural fairness and access to justice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guard against special interest influence on the courts
rubrics_metrics.description: We advocate for ... guarding against special interest influence on the courts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess reforms on their ability to limit special-interest groups' capacity to shape judicial behavior, appointments, or case outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Achieve a diverse bench
rubrics_metrics.description: Neither the state nor federal courts reflect the diversity of the communities they serve ... achieving a diverse bench.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use representativeness of the judiciary (demographic and experiential diversity) as a metric for healthier courts and for policy proposals aimed at diversifying appointments and elections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve federal judicial confirmation processes and public trust
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal judicial nominations have become increasingly contentious ... We urge reforms to improve the confirmation process and enhance public trust in our courts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate nomination and confirmation reforms by whether they reduce partisan contention, increase transparency, and restore public confidence in the judiciary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prevent use of flawed history to erode rights or federal power
rubrics_metrics.description: The Supreme Court is using flawed history to roll back individual rights and shrink the federal government’s power to solve problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A substantive jurisprudential standard: judicial reasoning should rely on sound historical methods and not misuse history to justify narrowing rights or federal authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Realize a fair and inclusive judicial system
rubrics_metrics.description: We work to realize a fair and inclusive judicial system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Overarching goal: judge reforms by whether they collectively produce fairness, inclusion, and legitimacy across all levels of the judiciary.
